about_the_game:
"Shadows of Midnight – They Watch Me Sleep" is a narrative-driven horror experience featuring two unique and terrifying stories of ordinary people facing the unknown.

Key features:

  • VHS Aesthetic: Optional VHS shaders for a nostalgic '90s horror feel.

  • Low-poly graphics: A mix of PS1/PS2-era visuals with modern lighting techniques.

  • Multiple endings: Each chapter has multiple endings, depending on your choices

  • Interactive dialog: Talk with in-game characters, and make choices during your dialog

This demo features one out of two horror stories that will be available in the full game:

THE HOTEL

A man’s peaceful summer vacation on the Croatian coast takes a sinister turn when he checks into an old, shady hotel. Strange things start happening in his room—objects move on their own, shadows shift in the dim light, and above his bed, a gaping, unnatural hole looms. Something is watching. You have to find out what's happening there.
